rows.verified: HSE's approved code and guidance is aimed at employers, dutyholders, managers and supervisors responsible for safe power-press use.
Power-press controls should include precautions that ensure the press can be used safely.
Power presses and their safeguards require thorough examination and inspection.
Dutyholders must retain the required examination, inspection and safety information.
PUWER requires work equipment to be suitable, maintained, inspected and used by properly instructed and trained people.
Power presses for cold metal require examination of the press and safeguards before first use and periodically afterwards.
A competent person must inspect and test guards and protection devices at the required intervals.
Maintenance logs, daily inspection checklists and periodic maintenance records support power-press safety assurance.
Power-press risk depends on press type, tooling, guarding, control mode, maintenance, material and operator competence.
Power-press evidence is machine-, safeguard-, task-, operator- and inspection-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Abrasive-wheel safety guidance identifies training as an essential control.
Users must understand wheel characteristics and select a wheel suitable for the machine and task.
Grinding-machine operations require safe operating procedures.
Abrasive wheels must be mounted using appropriate procedures and compatible components.
Suitable guards are a core control for abrasive-wheel machinery.
Portable and hand-held grinders require additional safety considerations.
Protective equipment requirements must be assessed alongside engineering controls.
PUWER requires grinding equipment to remain safe, maintained, inspected and accompanied by suitable protective devices.
Abrasive-wheel risk depends on wheel specification, speed, mounting, guarding, workpiece, environment and operator technique.
Abrasive-wheel evidence is wheel-, machine-, task-, environment- and operator-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
